editorialDirection: Food-shaped play grows into safe no-heat assembly and thoughtful presentation; delight comes from shape, balance and surprising design.
culturalTouch: A bright storybook courtyard kitchen, patterned serving trays and hospitality without royal hierarchy.
guardrails: Ages 1–3 use large felt pretend food only. Older children use pre-prepared ready-to-eat ingredients chosen for their needs, or explicitly pretend materials. No heat, knives, raw dough/flour, raw egg, food fights, unsafe tasting, choking-size decorations or pressure to eat. Adult safety preparation stays off-screen and is not the child's task. Not a recipe or nutrition guide.
